status.title: Sync with {{server}}. Click to sync now.
status.errorTitle: Sync failed: {{error}}. Click to try again.

account.keyWarning: This ID is the key to your data, like a password. Anyone who knows it can read your trips on the sync server. Do not share it publicly.
account.modeServer: Sync is on. Your trips are stored on {{server}} under a hash of this ID and are kept in step in every browser that uses the same ID.
account.modeLocal: No sync server is in use. Your trips stay in this browser only. To move them to another device, download a backup file and import it there.
account.invalidId: This is not a valid ID. Expected format: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal characters.
account.confirmServer_one: The {{count}} trip stored in this browser is removed here and replaced by the trips the server holds under the new ID. Trips under your current ID stay on the server.
account.confirmServer_other: The {{count}} trips stored in this browser are removed here and replaced by the trips the server holds under the new ID. Trips under your current ID stay on the server.
account.confirmLocal_one: The {{count}} trip stored in this browser is removed. Without a sync server the trips of another ID cannot be loaded, only a backup file brings them back. Download a backup first if you still need this data.
account.confirmLocal_other: The {{count}} trips stored in this browser are removed. Without a sync server the trips of another ID cannot be loaded, only a backup file brings them back. Download a backup first if you still need this data.

server.title: Sync server
server.note: Optional. Leave empty to use the server this page is served from, if there is one. A server you host yourself has to list this site in its CORS_ORIGINS setting.
server.label: Server URL
server.testNoSync: Reachable, but sync is disabled on that server.
server.invalidUrl: This is not a valid http or https URL.

delete.title: Data on the server
delete.note: Removes every trip stored on the server under this ID. The copy in this browser stays; it is not uploaded again unless you import it again.
delete.button: Delete my data on the server
delete.confirm: Yes, delete it on the server
delete.done: The data on the server was deleted.
